description: This PHP script interacts with the Redmine issue tracking system via its REST API. It retrieves details of a specific issue, displays some information, and adds a note to the issue. The script uses external Redmine API PHP library, handles multiple Redmine server configurations, and demonstrates how to fetch and update an issue.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class providing interface to Redmine's REST API for issue retrieval and update.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves an issue object from Redmine given an issue ID.

methods.name: addIssueNoteFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Adds a note (comment) to a specified issue in Redmine using a SimpleXML object.
